name: Old Town (Stari Grad)
tagline: Cobbled peninsula crowned by St Euphemia
description: The historic peninsula of steep cobbled alleys, pastel Venetian houses and the hilltop church of St Euphemia. Full of galleries, seafood konobas and boutique lodging, it is the postcard heart of Rovinj but crowded and pricey in high season.
bestFor: Short-stay travellers wanting the Adriatic old town and sea views

name: Centener
tagline: Residential district just east of centre
description: A largely residential neighbourhood east of the old town with apartment blocks, a school and everyday shops. Quieter and more affordable than the peninsula, it suits longer stays while remaining a short walk or cycle from the harbour and centre.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting quiet apartments near shops and local life

name: Monvi and Borik area
tagline: Resort and beach zone south of town
description: The southern tourist zone around Borik, home to large hotels, campsites, the Monvi entertainment centre and forested waterfront paths toward Zlatni Rt park. Green and leisure-focused, popular for beaches and nightlife, but a walk or bus from the old town.
bestFor: Travellers prioritising beaches, forest walks and summer nightlife

name: Gripole and Stancija Valente
tagline: Modern residential outskirts with local shops
description: Newer residential areas on the northeastern edge of town with apartments, supermarkets and the main bus links. Practical and quieter, with easy parking and lower rents, this is where many locals live, a short bus or bike ride from the seafront.
bestFor: Budget nomads with a car wanting space, parking and supermarkets
